concept.zh: 政府表格与公文：角上的表格编号、一格一格的填写框、小号大写的填表说明、勾选框、印章、复写联和虚线撕角。页面像一份需要逐项填写的正式申请，秩序本身就是权威。
concept.en: Government forms and official documents: a form number in the corner, boxed fields, instructions in small capitals, checkboxes, rubber stamps, carbon copies and perforated tear-offs. The page reads like an official application you work through line by line; order itself is the authority.

references: IRS Form 1040 and US federal forms printed by the Government Printing Office
British HMSO forms with “For official use only” panels
GB/T 9704-2012 党政机关公文格式（红头文件）
Carbonless triplicate sets on white / canary / pink NCR paper
Terry Gilliam, Brazil (1985) — Form 27B/6

tokens.grid: Form grid: 12 columns, 0 gutter — fields are cells sharing 1px borders (border-collapse); row heights 40px (single-line field) or 80px (multi-line); every field has a numbered label in its top-left corner at 10–11px.
tokens.radius: 0. Checkboxes are 14px squares. Only round seals use border-radius 50%.
tokens.border: Cells 1px solid var(--accent) in dropout palettes, otherwise var(--ink); part headers as reversed 24px bars; heavy 3px rule under the form title; perforations 1px dashed (4px/3px).
tokens.shadow: none. Carbon copies peek out by a 16px offset with a 1px rule outline — no blur.

must: Each fact sits in a labelled, numbered field or a numbered paragraph — no free-floating promotional copy.
The page carries a form or document number and a date or version.
Instructions are set smaller than field values, in small caps or uppercase.
Calls to action are phrased as form steps (“Complete Part III”, “Submit at counter 4”).
mustNot: No friendly onboarding UI: no rounded progress pills, illustrations or mascots.
No empty-looking fields when the facts supply the value — show the value typed in.
No real agency names, emblems or seals; the issuing body comes only from the facts.

voice.description: 把主题写成词典词条：词头、注音/词性、编号释义、例句、参见。
voice.example: 第四巷 dì sì xiàng ⟨名⟩ ① 一条只有一家面包店的巷子。

layout.name: Numbered field form
layout.description: A single form: header with form number and issuing body, then Parts I–III of boxed fields, each fact typed into a labelled field.
layout.grid: 12-column cell grid, max 960px; fields span 3, 4, 6 or 12 columns; part bars full width; a 120px shaded right column “For official use only”.
structure: Header: form number large top-left (e.g. “Form 27-B”), issuing body centred, reference number and year top-right
Instruction line in small caps: “READ THE NOTES ON PAGE 2 BEFORE COMPLETING THIS FORM”
Part I — Identification: name, address and contact as filled fields
Part II — Particulars: checkbox matrix and numbered fields with the real facts typed in
Part III — Declaration: signature, date and stamp area, then a perforated receipt stub

anchor.name: Form masthead
anchor.description: The first screen is the form header: giant form number, issuing body, year box, “Please print in black ink”, and Part I fields starting below.

type.name: IBM Plex Sans Condensed + IBM Plex Sans
type.notes: IBM Plex Sans Condensed 700 for titles and part bars at 24–36px; IBM Plex Sans 400 body at 15px/1.4; IBM Plex Mono for reference numbers, ISO dates (2026-11-01) and field values with tabular figures. For red-header notices the CJK issuing body is Noto Serif SC 900 (standing in for 方正小标宋), body text 16px.

stacks.display: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "Noto Serif SC", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif
stacks.body: "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", Arial, sans-serif

palette.name: Dropout-ink green
palette.usage: The pre-printed form (labels, boxes, part bars) in dropout green (accent ≈ 20%); filled-in data in ink; red (accent2) only for the serial number and “OFFICIAL USE ONLY” stamps; pale green panel for shaded official-use cells.

density.description: 信息密集，多栏并行；用细线和对齐建立秩序，首屏就能看到 3 个以上信息块。

motion.name: Rubber stamp
motion.description: On submit or click a stamp (“RECEIVED 01 NOV 2026”) lands: scale 1.3 → 1 and rotate to −8° while accelerating into the paper, then stops dead with uneven ink (SVG turbulence mask).
motion.reduced: The stamp appears in place at full size; no scale.

motif.name: Numbered field boxes
motif.description: Every value lives in a bordered box with a tiny numbered label in its top-left corner (“12b  Postal code”).

surface.name: Nth-generation photocopy
surface.description: Grey speckle and slightly thickened rules from repeated copying.
surface.css: background-color: var(--paper); background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,.07) 1px, transparent 1.2px); background-size: 5px 5px; filter: contrast(1.05);

twist.description: 至少一条 8px 以上的粗线（或双线）作为主分区手段，替代空白。

concept.zh: 包豪斯的基本形与三原色：康定斯基的黄三角、红方块、蓝圆，再加黑色粗条和圆点做骨架。拜尔的通用字体、莫霍利-纳吉的版式、阿尔伯斯的色彩练习——不对称的平衡，几何无衬线，像教学挂图一样清楚。
concept.en: Bauhaus elementary forms and primaries: Kandinsky’s yellow triangle, red square and blue circle, with black bars and dots as the skeleton. Herbert Bayer’s universal alphabet, Moholy-Nagy’s typophoto, Albers’ colour exercises — asymmetric balance, geometric sans, as clear as a teaching chart.

references: Herbert Bayer, Universal alphabet (1925) and Bauhaus exhibition posters
László Moholy-Nagy, Bauhausbücher covers (1925–1930)
Joost Schmidt, poster for the Bauhaus Exhibition Weimar (1923)
Josef Albers, Interaction of Color (1963) and Homage to the Square
Wassily Kandinsky, form–colour questionnaire (1923)

tokens.grid: 12 columns, 16px gutter, 32px margins; 8px baseline; compositions balance on an off-centre vertical axis at 5/12 or 7/12 (or a 30° diagonal), never at 6/12.
tokens.radius: 0 for rectangles; 50% only for true circles (dots, discs); triangles via clip-path: polygon().
tokens.border: 12–24px solid ink bars as structural dividers (only at 0° or 90°); 2px ink for small boxes; no hairlines.

must: At least two of the three elementary forms appear in primary colours.
The composition is asymmetric: main axis at 5/12 or 7/12 (or a diagonal), never at 6/12.
Headlines in a geometric sans; with the universal option, no capitals at all.
mustNot: No secondary or tertiary colours (purple, green, orange, pink) — only black, white/cream/grey and the primaries.
No gradients and no rounded rectangles — only true circles and sharp polygons.
No pictogram icons; shapes stay abstract.

voice.description: 访谈稿：问句短，答句是当事人的原话风格，具体、口语、有细节。
voice.example: 问：为什么周一休息？答：酵种也要歇一天。

layout.name: Bauhausbuch cover
layout.description: Bauhausbücher-style: a cover of heavy horizontal bars and one huge numeral or initial, then strict two-column interior pages.
layout.grid: 6 col, 24px gutter, 40px margin; bars 16px tall spanning 4–6 columns at staggered starts; interior text in 2 columns of 3.
structure: Cover: 2–3 horizontal black bars, one huge numeral or initial, title set between the bars
Contents: list where bar length encodes size/duration/price
Two-column body with section heads set on a coloured square
Back cover: imprint-style colophon with contact

anchor.name: Form composition
anchor.description: The first screen is an asymmetric arrangement of the three forms at large size (largest ≈45vw) with the headline set across one of them.

type.name: League Spartan + Kumbh Sans
type.notes: League Spartan 900 for blocky headlines set against or inside the bars, tracking -0.02em, line-height 0.9, uppercase allowed. Kumbh Sans body 16/1.55, 600 for labels.

stacks.display: "League Spartan", "ZCOOL QingKe HuangYou", Futura, Arial, sans-serif

palette.name: Primaries on cream
palette.usage: Cream paper; black bars and type. Red square, blue circle and yellow triangle each appear at least once; yellow panel is the largest colour area (≤20%), red ≤10%, blue ≤10%.

lines.verdict: large text / UI marks only (≥24px or bold ≥19px)

density.description: 常规阅读节奏；区块之间用明确的分隔（线、色块或编号），不靠空白硬撑。

motion.name: Form turn
motion.description: On hover a primary shape turns 90° (square) or 120° (triangle) in one mechanical move, like a piece of Alma Siedhoff-Buscher’s Bauhaus building game.
motion.reduced: No rotation; swap the shape’s colour instead.

motif.name: Albers squares
motif.description: Nested squares in Homage-to-the-Square proportions (10:8:6:4 units, inner squares dropped toward the bottom) as an image stand-in or section mark.

surface.name: Cut card
surface.description: Shapes look cut from coloured card; where two overlap, the intersection multiplies.

twist.description: 页脚写成书籍版权页：字体、纸张/配色、印次、地址等，是全页信息最密的区块。

concept.zh: 中国水墨与篆刻：山水的墨分五色，从焦墨晕开到淡墨再到纸白；文人画的题跋竖写在留白处，朱文、白文印章压在落款下。宣纸的纤维、手卷与立轴的比例——页面像一幅可以展开的画。
concept.en: Chinese ink painting and seal carving: ink in its five tones, from scorched black through washes to bare paper; literati inscriptions written vertically into the empty sky; red seals in relief (朱文) or intaglio (白文) pressed under the signature. Rice-paper fibre and the proportions of handscrolls and hanging scrolls — the page unrolls like a painting.

references: 黄公望《富春山居图》(1350)
八大山人 (Bada Shanren) ink paintings, late 17th century
吴昌硕 seal carving and calligraphy (1844–1927)
齐白石 paintings with inscriptions and seals
荣宝斋 木版水印 woodblock reproductions

tokens.grid: Scroll proportions: hanging-scroll column at 1:3 (≈520px wide, left of centre) or a horizontal handscroll track of 80–100vw sections; 24px gutters; mounting bands (天头 / 地头) of 8–12vh.
tokens.radius: 0 for mounts and square seals; 50% for round seals; seal edges roughened with an SVG displacement filter.
tokens.border: Mounting only: 12–24px panel-coloured silk border with a 1px ink inner line (隔水); no other boxes.
tokens.shadow: none; depth only through ink-wash tone.

must: At least one red seal (朱文 or 白文), and it is the only saturated colour on its screen.
On Chinese pages, titles or inscriptions are set vertically (writing-mode: vertical-rl) in a calligraphic CJK face.
Ink appears in at least three tonal values (e.g. 85/55/12%), after 墨分五色.
Bare paper (留白) covers at least 40% of the first screen.
mustNot: No pseudo-Asian “chop suey” Latin fonts and no brush-styled Latin text.
No dragons, lanterns, red-and-gold festival clichés.
No seal larger than the inscription it signs, except in the seal-as-title anchor.
No glossy gradients; washes fade into paper, never into colour.

voice.description: 观察者的记录：带日期、时间、度量和第一手细节，克制、不评价。
voice.example: 06:40 — 窗内温度 31°C，面团第二次发酵完成（目测体积 ×2）。

layout.name: Handscroll (手卷)
layout.description: A horizontal handscroll: content unrolls sideways in a scrolling track, each section a scene with its own inscription and seal.
layout.grid: Horizontal track (overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x proximity); sections 90vw × 80vh; vertical-rl inscriptions in 64px columns; on mobile the scenes stack vertically.
structure: 引首: the title in large calligraphy on the first panel
Scene 1: ink landscape with the main statement inscribed
Scenes 2–3: one per offering or fact group, each with a seal
跋: colophon with dates, names and contact, several small seals

anchor.name: Seal as title
anchor.description: A large carved 白文 seal (30–40vw) bearing the name is the title; the rest of the first screen is paper and one vertical line of text.

type.name: Liu Jian Mao Cao (草) + Zen Antique
type.notes: Liu Jian Mao Cao (cursive script) only for one or two expressive words — the name or a single character — at 120px+, as the painted gesture; never for information. All other CJK in Noto Serif SC 16/1.9. Latin headings Zen Antique, body Crimson Pro 17/1.6.

stacks.display: "Zen Antique", "Liu Jian Mao Cao", "Songti SC", serif

palette.name: Blue-green landscape on silk
palette.usage: 青绿山水 on aged silk: malachite green (and its 40% tint) for mountain washes (≈30% of the painting area); ink for outlines and text; seals in accent2; rule for mount lines.

lines.verdict: large text / UI marks only (≥24px or bold ≥19px)

density.description: 大留白，一屏只讲一件事；正文行长 60–68 字符（中文 30–36 字）。

motion.name: Ink bleed
motion.description: On the first screen only, ink washes and calligraphy appear by spreading: a radial mask grows from the brush entry point while blur(6px) settles to 0, like ink soaking into xuan paper.

motif.name: Seals (朱文 / 白文)
motif.description: Square or round seals: 朱文 = red strokes and thin red border on paper; 白文 = paper strokes cut out of a solid red block. Seal text in the CJK display face or SVG; edges roughened with feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap (scale 2–3).

surface.name: Xuan paper
surface.description: Rice paper with long soft fibres, faintly visible.
surface.css: background-color: var(--paper); background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27 width=%27240%27 height=%27240%27%3E%3Cfilter id=%27f%27%3E%3CfeTurbulence type=%27fractalNoise%27 baseFrequency=%27.015 .35%27 numOctaves=%273%27/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width=%27100%25%27 height=%27100%25%27 filter=%27url(%23f)%27 opacity=%27.07%27/%3E%3C/svg%3E");

twist.description: 用真实的时间/日期（营业时间、出炉时刻、日程）作为页面的主结构轴。

concept.zh: Riso 孔版印刷的双色套印：荧光粉和联邦蓝两种大豆油墨叠在一起，压出第三种颜色；版位总差一两毫米，平网的颗粒清清楚楚。每个颜色都是一张独立的版，设计就发生在两张版重叠的地方。
concept.en: Risograph two-colour printing: fluorescent pink and federal blue soy inks overprint to make a third colour, registration drifts by a millimetre or two, and every flat tint shows its grain. Each colour is a separate drum, and the design happens where the two layers overlap.

references: Hato Press (London) risograph publications
Colorama riso print studio (Berlin)
Nieves Books zines (Zurich)
Risotto Studio (Glasgow) prints and editions
Tokyo Art Book Fair riso zines

tokens.grid: 8 columns, 16px gutter, 32px margin; artwork lives on two "drum" layers that share the grid, with drum 2 offset 2px 3px from drum 1.
tokens.radius: 0 on text boxes; purely graphic shapes may be full circles or semicircles (border-radius: 50% only on shapes that carry no text).
tokens.border: No black outlines. Rules are 2px in one spot ink. Overlaps use mix-blend-mode: multiply.
tokens.shadow: none. The misregistration offset (drum 2 translated 2px 3px) is the only depth.

must: Exactly two spot inks (accent + accent2) plus paper; any third colour is their multiply overlap.
The first screen shows at least one visible overprint (mix-blend-mode: multiply) and one deliberate 2–4px misregistration.
Tints are grain or halftone screens of a spot ink, never opacity fades of black.
mustNot: No pure #000000 and no full-colour (CMYK-style) imagery.
No gradients between the two inks; transitions only via grain or halftone.
No drop shadows, outlines in black or glossy effects; riso ink is flat and slightly chalky.

voice.description: 黄历/年鉴口吻：宜忌、节令、方位，短句并列，带一点古意但信息准确。
voice.example: 宜：早起、趁热。忌：周一来访。

layout.name: Overprint poster
layout.description: A poster where a giant shape on drum 1 and a giant word on drum 2 overlap; the overlap prints the third colour; small information blocks sit in the corners.
layout.grid: 8 col; shape layer spans col 1–6, type layer col 3–8, overlapping across 4 columns; corner blocks 2 columns each.
structure: Top-left corner block: edition or issue number and date in small spot-ink type
Overlap field: giant circle or arch on drum 1 crossed by the subject name on drum 2, multiplied where they meet
Bottom band: three facts as a 3-column list with 2px spot-ink rules
Colophon strip: inks used ("fluorescent pink + federal blue"), paper stock, edition size if given in the facts

anchor.name: Overprint title
anchor.description: Subject name at 14–20vw in drum-2 ink crossing a giant drum-1 circle; the overlap shows the multiply colour.

type.name: Unbounded + Familjen Grotesk
type.notes: Unbounded 800 headlines, lowercase allowed, tracking -0.03em, line-height 0.92, up to 18vw; headlines always in a spot ink, never ink-black. Familjen Grotesk 400/600 body 17px/1.5; labels 600 uppercase +0.08em at 12px.

palette.name: Bright red + green on white
palette.usage: Crisp white stock; bright red for the big shapes, green for type and grain; dark green (both drums overprinted) for body text; at least 45% paper visible.

density.description: 大留白，一屏只讲一件事；正文行长 60–68 字符（中文 30–36 字）。

motion.name: Drum drift
motion.description: On hover, the drum-2 layer slides from its 2px 3px misregistration into perfect register, then back on leave.
motion.reduced: Keep the static misregistration; no slide.

motif.name: Grain tints
motif.description: Every tint is a stochastic grain or coarse halftone of a spot ink at 20–60% coverage, never an opacity fade.

surface.name: Coarse screen
surface.description: Tint areas printed as a 45° halftone with a 6px cell.
surface.css: background-image: radial-gradient(var(--accent) 34%, transparent 36%), radial-gradient(var(--accent) 34%, transparent 36%); background-size: 6px 6px; background-position: 0 0, 3px 3px;

twist.description: 页面里所有关键数字（时间、价格、编号）用展示字体、放大到正文 3 倍以上，作为视觉主角。

content.subject: 第四巷面包店
facts: 店名：第四巷面包店（Fourth Lane Bakery）
地址：老城区第四巷 17 号，巷口数第二个门，绿色木门
营业：周二至周日 7:00–19:00；周一休息
每天两炉：7:00 第一炉（乡村面包、可颂），11:00 第二炉（肉桂卷、黑麦面包）
卖完即止，当天不留货
乡村面包：天然酵种，48 小时低温发酵，整个 ¥38，半个 ¥20
黑麦面包：70% 黑麦，750 g，每日限 12 个，¥42
可颂：法国发酵黄油，¥16
肉桂卷：¥18，只在第二炉
酵种养了 9 年，店里叫它“老周”
面粉：本地石磨全麦粉 + 法国 T65
预订：提前一天 17:00 前，电话 021-5555-0417 或店内登记
周六 9:00–11:30 面包课，6 人小班，¥260/人，带走自己烤的面包
店主：周岚，前建筑师，2019 年开店
店内 6 个座位，手冲咖啡 ¥22

concept.zh: 弥敦道上空横伸出来的招牌、上海老街的竖匾：中文大字为主，英文小一号跟在下面；红底金字、绿底白字、黑漆描金，夜里霓虹灯管沿着同样的笔画勾出来。每块牌都写着铺号、行业、电话——它既是广告，也是门牌。
concept.en: The signs cantilevered over Nathan Road and the vertical plaques of old Shanghai streets: Chinese characters huge, English a size smaller beneath; gold on red, white on green, gilt on black lacquer, and at night neon tubes trace the same strokes. Every sign carries a shop number, a trade and a phone number — advertisement and address at once.

references: Nathan Road and Mong Kok projecting neon signs (1960s–2000s)
區建公 Au Kin-kung — hand-written shop-sign calligraphy, Hong Kong
M+ Museum — NEONSIGNS.HK collection and "Mobile M+: NEONSIGNS.HK" (2014)
Nanjing Road department stores 先施 Sincere / 永安 Wing On, Shanghai 1920s–30s
Hong Kong pawnshop 押 signs with the bat-and-coin emblem

tokens.grid: Sign-board grid: content is built from boards — horizontal boards 3:1 to 5:1, vertical boards 1:3 to 1:5. One CJK character = one square cell (1em × 1em) with a 0.12em gutter, so a board is N characters wide plus 2 × 0.4em frame.
tokens.radius: 0 for all boards. Only the shop-number roundel is a circle (border-radius: 50%); neon tubes use stroke-linecap: round and stroke-linejoin: round.
tokens.border: Boards are framed: 0.4em solid var(--accent2) outer frame plus a 2px inner line (outline: 2px solid var(--accent2); outline-offset: -10px). Section rules 3px solid var(--ink).
tokens.shadow: none on boards. Neon tubes may carry a tight 0 0 2px edge of their own colour (max 3px blur) — never a halo.

must: Chinese characters are the largest element on every board; English never exceeds 40% of the CJK size.
At least one vertical board using writing-mode: vertical-rl with upright characters.
Every sign carries a concrete address element from the facts: shop number, floor, street or phone.
Neon is drawn as line work — the path of the tube is visible.
mustNot: No glow blobs, blurred halos or text-shadow larger than 4px; no cyberpunk gradients.
No sideways-rotated Chinese in vertical text.
No Latin-only boards; every board is bilingual or Chinese-only.

voice.description: 说明书口吻：编号条款、动词开头、规格写全，零形容词。
voice.example: 3.2 取货：报预订号 → 核对 → 取走。逾时 30 分钟释放库存。

layout.name: Projecting sign stack
layout.description: A street canyon: vertical boards hang from the right edge at staggered heights while horizontal boards carry the content on the left.
layout.grid: 12 col, 16px gutter; cols 1–8 content boards; cols 10–12 hold 2–3 vertical boards (1:4) stacked with 24px gaps, each dropped by one-third of the previous; vertical text uses writing-mode: vertical-rl.
structure: Vertical shop-name board at the right, 4–6 characters, gold on red, upright characters
Horizontal trade board at the left: what the place sells, English line beneath at ⅓ size
Shop-number roundel + address line (地铺 / 1/F / street number from the facts)
Price or service list as a lacquered board: items left, prices right in lining figures
Hours and phone on a narrow green strip board; footer repeats the name as a neon outline

anchor.name: Hanging vertical
anchor.description: A tall 1:4 vertical board hangs at the right, cut off by the top of the viewport as seen from the pavement, beside a horizontal trade board.

type.name: Ma Shan Zheng + Antonio + Hanken Grotesk
type.notes: Brush characters (Ma Shan Zheng, single weight) at 120–200px, tracking 0.05em, one board = one phrase. English in Antonio 700 uppercase +0.04em at ⅓ of the CJK size, like the small English on a Mong Kok sign. Prices in Antonio 600 with the currency sign at 60%.

palette.name: Neon street at night
palette.usage: Warm near-black street; neon tubes in pink (accent) and teal (accent2) as 3–4px strokes and outline text only (≤ 10% of pixels); boards are panel brown-black with cream characters.

density.description: 常规阅读节奏；区块之间用明确的分隔（线、色块或编号），不靠空白硬撑。

motion.name: Lacquer swap
motion.description: No movement. Hovering a board swaps gold ↔ red (frame and characters reverse), like a night-lit board.
motion.reduced: Same — it is a colour swap only.

motif.name: Vertical board
motif.description: Tall boards with upright CJK characters (writing-mode: vertical-rl; text-orientation: upright), a gold double frame, and small English running along the bottom edge.

surface.name: Gold-leaf characters
surface.description: Characters in flat gold with a 1px darker edge — no metallic gradients.
surface.css: color: var(--accent2); -webkit-text-stroke: 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent2) 70%, black);
